authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed policy source, source-adapter contracts, immutable interaction receipts, and operator-approved private state.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues and versioned ranking-policy specifications with observable explanation and privacy criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Deterministic offline replay, counterfactual policy evaluation, source trust checks, and explicit operator review.
authority.deployment_authority: Private operator-controlled runtime; public source and learned candidates have no automatic access to personal accounts or state.

data.retention: Private candidates, interactions, source receipts, preferences, and policy outcomes follow explicit operator retention and purpose rules.
data.deletion: Operator deletion removes private records and derived indexes; policy candidates trained from removed material require impact review or retirement.
data.secret_storage: OAuth tokens, account credentials, and private runtime state remain outside Git in operator-controlled storage.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Ranking policies, adapters, grants, and learned candidates remain versioned, independently reversible, and operator revocable.

stabilization.summary: Attach exact source, trust, purpose, permitted-use, freshness, and prompt-injection classification to every candidate input.
Evaluate policy changes against frozen interactions, counterfactual alternatives, explanation quality, and privacy leakage before promotion.
Treat learned ranking revisions as immutable candidates requiring independent evaluation and explicit operator promotion.
